audience: SendPost customers reviewing email delivery and sending infrastructure

useCases.title: Compare delivery statistics
useCases.text: Use an account key to read daily or aggregate delivery, bounce and engagement counts across sub-accounts over a date range.

useCases.title: Inspect sending IPs and pools
useCases.text: Use an account key to inspect sending IP warmup states and IP pool routing or overflow settings without changing them.

useCases.title: Audit sending-domain configuration
useCases.text: Use a sub-account key to inspect domain DNS records, verification status and failure reasons without creating or verifying domains.

useCases.title: Review suppressed recipients
useCases.text: Use a sub-account key to review suppressed recipients and their reasons over a date range. This does not add or remove suppressions.

useCases.title: Inspect message metadata
useCases.text: Use an account key to look up a submitted message’s sender, recipient, subject and routing metadata. Results exclude message bodies, attachments and custom headers.
